critical_code_review_comments: Informational only: on reload the native scroll restoration lands at a shallower Y than before the reload (5667 -> 1507) because ScrollTrigger pin-spacers are created after restoration. Not a defect introduced by this change, but if exact-position reload fidelity matters, set history.scrollRestoration='manual' and re-apply the target scroll after ScrollTrigger.refresh().

StatementScene keeps .st-w2/.st-w3 at opacity 1 parked offscreen (x=2112 / y+880) during the whole materialization. Visually correct today, but it relies on fromTo immediateRender; an explicit tl.set of their start transforms at time 0 would make the state independent of GSAP's render order.
